claims.statement: EMA is building interoperable, machine-to-machine shortage reporting for authorities and marketing-authorisation holders, showing that structured supply, demand, and availability feeds are feasible. A founder's narrower route is an internal inventory feed plus pre-authorised branch-transfer rules inside one pharmacy or hospital group; ESMP does not itself grant pharmacy data access.

The measurable loss is a critical SKU unavailable at one location while substitutable or soon-to-expire stock sits elsewhere, producing missed dispensing, staff search time, and possible expiry. EMA reports 70 critical-shortage notifications discussed in 2025 and six solidarity procedures, but local branch-level mismatch value is not quantified.

The payer hypothesis is a pharmacy group or hospital procurement director using inventory, procurement, and shortage-mitigation budget for internal rebalancing and forecasting. The proposed Critical Medicines Act makes resilient procurement a policy direction, but no Polish buyer has confirmed a software or success-fee budget.

contrary_evidence: National shortage systems, wholesalers, and ESMP may absorb much of the forecasting and coordination function.
Cross-company transfers or brokering of medicines can require wholesale authorisation and may be impermissible, so the initial wedge must stay inside an authorised group and its approved procedures.

economics.acquisition_route: Pilot read-only forecasting in a single multi-branch pharmacy or private hospital group, then enable only its compliance-approved internal transfers for a small critical-SKU list; do not intermediate title to medicines.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A trusted local availability graph could expand from internal rebalancing to supplier risk analytics and authorised procurement coordination across Central Europe; material equity requires integrations that survive public-platform improvements.
economics.founder_time: About 12-18 hours per week for data engineering, forecasts, and workflow design; pharmacists and authorised procurement staff approve substitutions and movements.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription software margin after integration and support; medicine inventory, credit, and regulated transport remain with customers or wholesalers.
economics.payback: Require a 90-day retrospective analysis to identify avoidable stockout or expiry value exceeding annual subscription before building live integrations.
economics.pricing: Per-location monthly fee plus an optional capped success fee on documented expiry avoidance or recovered dispensing inside the group.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Forecasting and rebalancing run daily; integration into replenishment and approved transfer rules creates renewal value.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Branch-level demand, stock, expiry, transfer, and shortage-response outcomes for critical SKUs
fingerprint.customer: Multi-branch pharmacy groups and private hospital procurement networks in Poland
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Pharmacy-software integrators, procurement advisors, and direct group-level pilots
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Internal shortage forecasting and compliance-approved stock rebalancing sold per location with optional savings share
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Procurement leader pays during recurring shortage and inventory cycles; value is realized on avoided stockout or expiry
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A critical medicine becomes unavailable at one branch while the group lacks a reliable view of movable stock elsewhere

founder_fit: Time-series forecasting and constrained allocation are strong matches for the founder's data-science background.
The product can be built without public-facing influence or holding regulated inventory.
A retrospective data pilot can test economic value before material spend.
risks: Pharmacy inventory data is highly sensitive and legacy systems may not expose usable feeds.
Optimization recommendations could conflict with patient need, substitution law, or wholesaler allocations.
The addressable gap may disappear as official systems become more granular and interoperable.

structure.commercial_archetype: Federated inventory intelligence and constrained internal exchange network
structure.control_point: The live branch inventory feed plus the group's pre-approved transfer and allocation rules
structure.critical_dependency: Legal, timely access to inventory and demand data inside an entity allowed to move the medicines

thesis: Backcast from a federated European critical-medicine supply network: start below public reporting with the branch-level allocation decision, proving that one authorised group can rescue stock before a stockout or expiry and letting its response graph compound.
title: Shortage Transfer Network
uncertainties: The share of stockouts caused by within-group allocation rather than upstream shortage is unknown.
A buyer has not confirmed that recovered dispensing or expiry avoidance can be measured credibly.
Polish rules and wholesaler contracts governing internal transfers need specialist review.
